new_material_candidates.name: Nemori — What Deserves Memory: Adaptive Memory Distillation for LLM Agents
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Uses episodic integration plus prediction-error-driven semantic knowledge distillation to determine what interaction information deserves durable retention rather than relying on fixed importance heuristics.

new_material_candidates.name: EMA — An Episodic Memory Agent for Efficient and Selective Memory
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Abstracts interactions into episodic memory units and adds MemDecider as a learned selective filtering module that controls low-value information before long-term storage.

new_material_candidates.name: StructMem — Structured Memory for Long-Horizon Behavior in LLMs
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Preserves factual and relational event bindings with temporal anchors and periodically synthesizes cross-event summaries, providing a distinct hierarchical structured-memory mechanism.
